This library incorporates the supplied Notion export and links its material to the study notes and paper reviews.
The two exported CSV files contain the same 115 records, with a different ordering of columns and entries.
The records include topic dividers, two unnamed empty entries, a template, a glossary, and presentation links as well as papers.

Read and Status below reproduce the export as separate fields.
A review link means that a note is available here; it does not change the exported reading status.
Entries without substantive exported notes remain in the queue.

## Starting points

The [study notes](../study-notes/index.qmd) connect definitions to paper mechanisms.
The exported Jargon page is integrated into [probability and information](../study-notes/mathematics/probability.qmd#random-variables), [policies and learning regimes](../study-notes/machine-learning/policies.qmd), [attention](../study-notes/machine-learning/attention.qmd#projections), and [representations](../study-notes/machine-learning/representations.qmd).

## Presentation sources

| Original presentation | Study destinations |
|---|---|
| Generative Models, 23 September 2025 | [VAE](../study-notes/machine-learning/autoencoders.qmd#vae), [DDPM](theory/ddpm.qmd), [GAN](theory/gan.qmd), [normalising flows](theory/normalizing-flows.qmd), and [flow matching](theory/flow-matching.qmd). |
| State-Space Models, 14 October 2025 | [State-space models](../study-notes/machine-learning/state-space-models.qmd), [matrix dynamics](../study-notes/mathematics/matrix-dynamics.qmd#properties), and [Mamba](theory/mamba.qmd). |

The linked notes incorporate these presentations with revised equations and explanations.

## Corrections to retain

| Original ambiguity or error | Corrected explanation |
|---|---|
| Cross-entropy expectation lost its minus sign. | [Entropy and KL](../study-notes/mathematics/entropy.qmd#kl-divergence). |
| Conditional meant one data point and marginal meant many. | [Conditional and marginal distributions](../study-notes/mathematics/probability.qmd#conditional-and-marginal). |
| Online and offline processing were reversed. | [Online and offline](../study-notes/machine-learning/policies.qmd#online-and-offline). |
| Forward and inverse Jacobian determinants were treated as equal. | [Normalising flow density](theory/normalizing-flows.qmd). |
| Non-normality was treated as sufficient for transient growth. | [A stable counterexample](../study-notes/mathematics/matrix-dynamics.qmd#transient-amplification). |
| Woodbury used a plus sign for the inverse correction. | [Woodbury derivation](../study-notes/mathematics/matrix-dynamics.qmd#woodbury). |
| A generic gate was presented as the full Mamba parameterisation. | [Mamba parameter roles](theory/mamba.qmd). |
| MAE could name a loss or a vision paper. | [Mean absolute error](../study-notes/machine-learning/loss.qmd#loss-and-risk) and the Masked Autoencoders queue entry are different topics. |
